study.title: Improved weed segmentation in UAV imagery of sorghum fields with a combined deblurring segmentation model
study.short_title: DeBlurWeedSeg: Deblurring + Segmentation for UAV Sorghum Fields

segmentation.best_model: DeBlurWeedSeg (NAFNet deblur + ResNet-50 WeedSeg), trained on sharp images only

dataset.name: Experimental sorghum field, southern Germany (Chenopodium album main weed, Cirsium arvense minor)
dataset.note: DJI Mavic 2 Pro (20 MP Hasselblad L1D-20c), 5 m AGL, velocity 6.9 km/h, wind 6 km/h, GSD 1 mm, sorghum BBCH stage 13, Sept 2020; two flights (Hover-and-Capture sharp + Capture-at-Equal-Distance blurred) matched into 1300 non-overlapping blurry/sharp 128x128 pairs; classes soil/background, sorghum, weeds; hold-out test = 100 patches, backg. >98% of pixels.

segmentation.backbone: ResNet-50 (best encoder; ImageNet init); NAFNet (deblurring encoder-decoder)

mIoU.ambiguity: Study uses Sorensen-Dice coefficient as primary metric (class imbalance); mIoU not reported.

mPA.ambiguity: Only per-class accuracy in confusion matrices; background >99.8%.

F1.ambiguity: Sorensen-Dice coefficient (DS) used as the primary metric; DS is equivalent to F1 for binary evaluation.

Dice.ambiguity: DS on combined (sharp + motion-blurred) hold-out test set, scenario 2 (trained on sharp only). Sharp subset 0.8741, blurred subset 0.8011. Relative improvement +13.4% over WeedSeg baseline (combined ~0.738). Validation-selected ResNet-50 encoder DS 0.9048.

PA.ambiguity: Pixel accuracy not reported; only per-class accuracy via confusion matrices (background >99.8%).

weed_F1.ambiguity: Per-class relative improvements on blurred set: ~+137% weed class and ~+117% sorghum class segmentation accuracy vs WeedSeg; absolute per-class DS not tabulated.

fps.ambiguity: No inference speed/latency reported; trained/evaluated on 4x NVIDIA RTX 3090.

issues: Primary metric is Sorensen-Dice; mIoU/mPA not reported.
DeBlurWeedSeg includes prior NAFNet deblurring step - combined-model performance attributed to joint pipeline.
Dataset from a single UAV mission (one field, one growth stage, Chenopodium album dominant).
